candidates.title: The Chair Outside The Door
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu is not made visually hard to understand; the frame shows the exact care required when she cannot explain herself yet.
suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: Quiet hallway, closed door, empty chair, question text.
Slide 2: Zuv's hand leaves water and charger on the chair, then exits frame.
Slide 3: Time passes through chair distance, changed light, and object placement.
Slide 4: Door cracked open, water half empty, charger in use.
Slide 5: Morning payoff with cloth pulled inside and Zuv partly asleep in chair.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Closed door on one side, chair outside, off-white negative space.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: A hand from inside pulls the cloth while the chair proves he stayed nearby.
candidates.visual_evidence: Door, chair, light strip, water, charger, folded cloth, morning light.
candidates.share_or_comment_trigger: People recognize the person who stays close without demanding access.
candidates.why_not_generic: The scene has a physical behavior and repeated objects; it is not a quote over a mood.
candidates.visual_potential: Excellent: clean, legible, low crowding, low identity-drift risk, strong prop continuity.
failure_risks: Too empty if the hallway lacks prop evidence.
Zuv must not look like a martyr.
Payoff must not become a hug.

scene_landing_preview_seed.first_frame_visual: A quiet off-white hallway; closed door; empty chair; thin warm light under the door.
scene_landing_preview_seed.hook_text_direction: am i hard to love when i go quiet?
scene_landing_preview_seed.payoff_frame: Used water/charger and cloth pulled inside; Zuv partial, not centered.
scene_landing_preview_seed.send_or_comment_trigger: This is what gentle presence looks like.
scene_landing_preview_seed.flat_or_generic_risk: Sad empty hallway without object continuity.

candidates.title: The Bag That Knew Already
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu wonders if she is hard to handle while Zuv's bag quietly reveals he learned her real care instructions.
suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: Open sling bag flat-lay with care objects and hook.
Slide 2: Aachu alone near the edge of a public place.
Slide 3: One object appears in use.
Slide 4: Zuv partly shown opening bag or creating space.
Slide 5: Quiet corner with bag between them.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Open bag, water, snack, scarf, charger; no faces needed.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Used bag sits between them like a third character.
candidates.visual_evidence: Bag and care objects repeated across slides.
candidates.why_not_generic: Props carry the relationship rather than a generic reassurance line.
candidates.visual_potential: Very strong if the object count is disciplined.
failure_risks: Public place should be silhouettes only.
Needs one object to matter twice.

scene_landing_preview_seed.first_frame_visual: Open bag on off-white textured ground, clear text space above.
scene_landing_preview_seed.hook_text_direction: am i hard to handle, or do i come with instructions?
scene_landing_preview_seed.payoff_frame: Bag open and used between them.
scene_landing_preview_seed.send_or_comment_trigger: Tag the person who knows your care kit.

candidates.title: The Lamp Left Low
candidates.one_line_concept: The fear is not being too much; it is whether someone will make the room gentle when Aachu cannot be gentle yet.
suggested_slide_arc: Slide 1: Aachu alone with phone face-down and too-bright room.
Slide 2: Zuv's hand lowers the lamp or switches overhead light off.
Slide 3: Cup, curtain, pillow or fan changes.
Slide 4: Aachu's guarded posture opens slightly.
Slide 5: Two cups in softened room, one figure partial or absent.
candidates.suggested_slide_1_moment: Aachu alone, phone face-down, strong negative space.
candidates.suggested_payoff_moment: Same room gentler, with two cups and no forced embrace.
candidates.visual_evidence: Light switch/lamp, phone, tea cup, curtain, changed posture.
candidates.why_not_generic: Reassurance is shown through the environment changing.
candidates.visual_potential: High but more atmospheric than the door idea.
failure_risks: Lighting can become dark concept-style mood.
Hands near lamp/cup must stay simple.
